newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Glorious Sun IPO over 200 times subscribed - sources.
newsitem.headline: Glorious Sun IPO over 200 times subscribed - sources.

text.p: Initial public offering of shares of casual wear maker and retailer Glorious Sun Enterprises Ltd was seen over 200 times subscribed at close of the offer on Tuesday, market sources said.
Sources said the grey market price was seen to range from HK$2.00 to HK$2.10 per share on Tuesday.
An offical announcement on the subscription results will be made on Thursday. Dealing in the company shares is expected to begin on September 17.
HSBC Investment bank Asia Ltd is the global coordinater.

Glorious Sun has offered 250 million new shares total, comprising a retail offer of 100 million and a placement of 150 million, in both cases at HK$1.60 per share. It said it would reallocate 25 million shares from placing to the retail offering if that portion was over three times subscribed.

The company said proceed would be used to further develop and expand its Jeanswest retail network in China, Australia and New Zealand. It also makes jeans for retailers including The GAP, JC Penney, Phillip Van Heusen, Structure and Haggar.
